Parashat Hachodesh: "This month is for you the first of the months etc. Midrash: This is similar to a king who betrothed a woman and wrote for her a small gift. Since it came the time to collect it (The Gift), he (The King) wrote for her a large gift. So to this world is likened to betrothal (from God to the Jewish People), as it says (in the verse) "I will betroth you to me forever." And (God only gave them the moon alone. As it says (in the verse) "This month is for you." However, in the days of Messiah there will be (a) marriage. As it says (in the verse) "For He who made you will espouse you". At that time he will give them (the Jews) everything. As it says (in the verse) "And the wise will shine like the shine of the sky, and the ones who lead the many in the way of righteousness (will shine) like stars forever and ever. This is the end of the words of the Midrash:
To explain and understand the essence of the intention of the sages
Vayakhel: Six days shall you do work, etc.: Behold in this parshah, the holy Torah has the warning (prohibition) of Shabbat precede the building of the tabernacle; yet in Parshat Ki Tissa, it has the building of the tabernacle precede the observance of Shabbat!?! But this can be explained on its simple level as follows: That in truth the Sages, may their memory be blessed, said that the tabernacle came to atone for the sin of the golden calf. This is as can be seen from all of the verses that were stated in the building of the tabernacle that are to repair [it] are in the exact same language [used] when they sinned, as it is found in the Midrash in the Torah commentators, see there. However it appears that in truth, even if the Jewish people had not sinned with the calf, they would have still made the tabernacle, as God, may He be blessed, said to Moshe (Exodus 25:8), "They shall make a sanctuary for Me, and I will dwell in their midst." For the tabernacle was built in the aspect of a copy resembling the sanctuary above, the chamber across from the chamber, etc. And the Holy One, blessed be He, commanded to make the sanctuary below in order to draw down the manifestation of the Divine Presence among the descendants of Israel, His treasured nation. However afterwards, when they made the calf, another reason and intention was added for them in the building of the tabernacle, and that is atonement; which was added on the first reason, which was to bring down the manifestation of the Divine Presence among them. But behold the observance of Shabbat is also a reparation for the sin of the calf. This is as the Sages, may their memory be blessed said (Shabbat 118b:2), "Anyone who observes Shabbat, etc. even if he worships idolatry, etc. is forgiven." So Shabbat is a personal reparation for any Jew who observes Shabbat in accordance with its status and its law; then he will be forgiven for his sin. But the offering for the tabernacle is a general reparation. Hence in this parshah, which was after the Yom Kippur subsequent to the sin of the calf, the holy Torah had the observance of Shabbat precede the building of the tabernacle, so it mentioned the personal reparation before the general reparation. But it did not do this in Parsha Ki Tissa, for that was still before the sin of the calf. There the Torah had the building of the tabernacle, which is the place for the manifestation of the Divine Presence, precede before the observance of Shabbat. And see the holy Ohr HaChaim, may his memory be blessed, who spoke a little about this.
Bamidbar: With the help of the mighty God, we begin to write the Book of Bamidbar (Numbers).

“And He spoke… in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent… on the first…” One must understand and know why Scripture here specifies the place and time of the Divine speech, something it does not generally do regarding the commandments of the Torah or other matters, and there are many further textual nuances evident to any thoughtful person. However, upon careful reflection, one may explain according to the inner truth that the Holy Torah is revealing here wondrous, hidden, and awe-inspiring matters. For it is written, “He wraps Himself in light as in a garment,” and it is known and explained by us many times that the Creator, blessed and exalted be He, in His abundant mercy and holy lovingkindness, desired to bestow goodness upon Israel, His holy people, children of the Living God, for whose sake He emanated, created, formed, and made all the upper holy worlds and the lower worlds. He wished to make known to them and sanctify them through His holy commandments, and to reveal to them His awesome powers, greatness, and mighty acts through His deeds. Yet since no thought can grasp Him whatsoever, and He is beyond all comprehension, especially beyond the grasp of mortal physical humanity, therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, emanated, as it were, a pure and radiant light from the splendorous garment enveloping Him, descending through the holy chain of emanation, so that His beloved people might be able to know and perceive, as it were, His divinity through His actions, and thereby cleave to His holy commandments and to this holy and awesome “garment.” This holy garment is the mystery of the Supernal Garment, numerically corresponding to the sacred names “Or Pnei El” and to the holy mystery of “Chashmal,” for the numerical values are equal and all are one. Concerning “Chashmal,” the sages taught: “At times they are silent, and at times they speak.” This alludes to the holy names: the Divine Name הוי״ה exists in thought alone — this is the “silent” aspect — while the Divine Name אדנ״י is manifest in speech — this is the “speaking” aspect. When these are unified and joined in the mystery of Oneness through the commandments and good deeds performed by Israel with God, they become one word: “Chashmal.” Thus, here, when the Holy One, blessed be He, wished to command Moses our teacher to count Israel, His holy people, and to show him the proper path, how to elevate them, uplift them, and raise them back to their source, root, and the source of the root of their souls in holiness, He therefore spoke to him from this very aspect. “Bemidbar Sinai” numerically equals “Chashmal,” and from this aspect, the glorious and awesome Creator spoke with him. This secret and mode of Divine conduct was then transmitted to Moses in the “Tent of Meeting.” “Ohel” (“tent”) denotes illumination and clarity, as in the verse “When His lamp shone over my head,” meaning that He spoke to him from that radiant and pure light which shines into the temporal world, and this is the meaning of “Tent of Meeting,” for “mo’ed” also signifies time, since at that moment Moses needed to receive the form of speech and guidance appropriate to the world of time. “On the first day of the second month” refers to the sacred permutation among the twelve permutations of the Divine Name that shines during the second month, Iyar, namely יהה״ו, derived from the verse “Let him who glories glory only in this: understanding and knowing Me.” It is known that through the twelve sacred permutations of the Divine Name all the worlds, upper and lower, were renewed, created, and established, and this permutation is the second of the twelve; thus, it is called “the second renewal.” This is the meaning of “on the first” — from the true simple Unity, the mystery of the supreme holy Crown, which shines into the second renewal, and this is the mystery of the upper holy Heh, the World of Binah, an aspect called “the pleasantness of God.” “In the second year” — “year” signifies the complete cycle of all the holy and awesome powers that shine and are included within the mystery of holy kingship, thus “in the second year” refers to the second Heh of the Divine Name, the aspect of holy sovereignty. When all these aspects become unified in the mystery of Oneness, this is the secret of “Chashmal” hinted at in the words “Bemidbar Sinai,” as explained. “Lift up the head of the entire congregation of Israel according to their families, according to their fathers’ houses” means to elevate and raise them to the source of all sources and the root of all roots of the souls of Israel, the aspect called “Israel is holy unto God, the first of His produce,” the mystery of supernal holy Wisdom. “According to their families” derives from a language of attachment and joining, while “according to their fathers’ houses” refers to holy Wisdom called “Father.” They were all included and attached through the power of the holy and awesome Aleph-Bet and were to be elevated yet further to an even higher and more exalted level of holiness. “By the number of names, every male according to their headcount” — “number” here signifies sapphire-like brilliance and radiant illumination, while “every male” refers to the aspect of bestowal, meaning that all the radiance of Divine flow should be elevated and drawn down to the congregation of God, the children of the Living God. “To their skulls” alludes to the “Skull of the Holy King,” as it were, and from there all joy, goodness, and supernal holy illumination are drawn forth and bestowed upon Israel above and below, may this be His will. And the enlightened person will understand all this, for these are ancient and profound matters. As for the remaining teachings, I did not merit to hear them directly from his holy mouth speaking, and therefore I refrained from recording them in writing, for I was afraid.
Pinchas: And the daughters of Tzelofchad ben Chefer approached etc - look, it is written "Joyfully shall you draw water from the fountains of salvation" (Isaiah 12:3). Salvation is called in the aspect of the High Holy Crown, which is where exists the fountain/origin of salvation, lovingkindness and compassion. And the two springs that come from it are Yud and Hey, which are Chochmah and Binah. And from there comes the Flow and the Salvation to the five aspects that are called the Five Salvations. And this is what we say in Havdalah "the cup of salvations I raise etc" since just as the cup is a vessel that receives the  wine that is poured into it, so too is the level of "the one who claims needs to show proof", which is the Higher Sovereingty, as it were. This is the vessel to receive the Five Salvations, through the aspect of "the tzadik is the life of the worlds", since he is connected to all, and joyfully draws, and this is the secret of "the tzadik is the life of the worlds". The sages have said that JOY is a metaphor for the covenant, which is the Flow and Filling of the cup of salvation, and "the one who claims needs to show proof" is the one that wants to raise oneself up to their source and their root of Holiness. And the holy Zohar says that the five fingers around the cup are a hint of the five salvations that come from the Upper World, which is the World of Freedom, as known to those who know. ... And those are symbolized by the letters mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf, which are both simple and double. And those five salvations are called "daughters of Tzelofchad", and this is the explanation of the verse "and the daughters of Tzelofchad approached": they approached themselves to their higher root, that are the five salvations spoken of above, since they are called daughters that surround the Shechinah since they receive the flow from the Higher Source. And they are called daughters of Tzelofchad - [break this word into] tzalap chad [one mark], those who are one since they have no dispersion, in the secret meaning of two rays that do not separate. OR you can also say - daughters of Tzelofchad [break this word into] tzel pachad [shadow of fear] since the five letters mem-nun-tzadi-pei-chaf are double they are the hint to the Holy Strengths, and from there come Fear and Awe into those who hate Israel and all who do evil, that they are unable to come to the higher holiness. They are not able to do evil to Israel, because they [Israel] desire and want those five salvations, which are symbolized by the settling and inheriting the holy land. And that they [the daughters] were able to go up to their Source and their High Root so as to make the flow descend and fill up the cup of salvations, which is the secret of the Holy Sovereignty. And their desire was to bring about salvation and redemption, which is the messianic times, which is "and the daughters of Tzelofchad ben Chefer approached", since it is known that the secret of Exile is to raise the 288 (Refech) holy sparks, hinted in the letters of Chefer. And "Son of Gilead" - through Yaakov Our Father who called him Gal-ed, and this is also a hint to the world of freedom, in which there is the sweetening of the judgments, and there one is an E"D (witness) that the ability of changing Names for God is how we conquer our enemies, which are the ones that try to cross over the GaL (wall of stones), like the way Lavan the Aramean tried to fool Yaakov, crossing over the wall of stones to do evil to Israel. OR one can say Ben Gila"d, E"D (witness) Ayin and Dalet. Ayin and Dalet are augmented in the verse Shema etc Echad, which are the letters of E"D. Since we are with the Blessed One and we unify God's name, above and below, and we give witness to God's unity, Blessed be the Name.And what is left of the letters of Shema is SH"M, and from Echa"d, A"CH; so we can make the combination ASHMA"CH (which is Shem Ach due to our witnessing of the unity of the Holy Blessed One, and this is Ben Gil"ad, that it becomes revealed to us the Name A"ch brother/ an idea of God as Brother, through the E"D written augmented.) Ben Machir - Ben Machir with patach - that he will recognize and know and reveal and publicize the Holy One of Blessing to Israel. And as it is written "For a child has been born to us, a son has been given us. And authority has settled on his shoulders...in token of abundant authority and of peace without limit" (Isaiah 9:5-6). Ben Menashe. From the expression "God has made me forget completely my hardship" (Genesis 41:51). That is, through him Israel forgot completely all their hardship in exile. And these are the names of his daughters: the five salvations spoken above, each with her specific name, due to the good action that each has. The name of the first is Machl"ah - from the expression machul lah - it is forgiven to her, there is the source of Forgiveness (Selichah); or the expression "forgiven to the righteous." The name of the second is to be read together with the name of the first: Machla"h Noa"h, meaning constantly advancing [n"a] sickness from the seed of Israel due to the sweetening of judgments. The name of the third Chogla"h: from the expression Cha"g La"h (a festival to her), happiness and rejoicing there. The name of the fourth Milka"h: the revealing of the holy sovereignty (Malkhut). The name of the fifth Tirtza"h: a hint that Kneset Israel (?) is happy in the presence of the Holy One of Blessing, to do all according to their will after the revelation of the higher light, the world of freedom. And to become sorry (metzerah), wanted (ratzah) from the sweetening of judgment, and all becomes Compassion. And THIS IS the explanation of "and they stood (fem. verb) - the five salvations spoken of above. In front of Moshe - the aspect of Awareness (Da'at). And in front of Eleazar haKohen - the higher (sphere). And in front of etc, why will the name of our father be diminished etc give us a holding etc - since through Israel Sh"en A"ch (the name Brother) is remembered (and expanded) influencing (the world) - this is "among the brothers of our father". A"v (father) is an expression of will, like "and they did not want" Av"u (Judges, 19:25; I Samuel 15:9) - our will is that we have a holding on the aspect of Brother A"ch remembered/male. And this is "among the brother of our father". And this is "they brought their claim to Moshe" - the world of freedom, the 50 levels of Binah. In front of Hashem - specifically. "And Moshe spoke to Ad-nai" - the aspect of Awareness. "
Devarim: These are the words that Moses addressed to all Israel on the other side of the Jordan etc after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites etc (Deut. 1:1 - Deut. 1:4) - One needs to understand: isn't explained in the words of our sages that whenever the expression "these" is used it cancels what came before? And what is cancelled here with "these"? Also, at first glance the expression "on the other side of the Jordan" is unnecessary, since we already know it, given that we read the end of Mas'ei (Numbers 36:13). Also, what is the need for the Torah to give the indication "after he defeated Sihon"? Didn't we know this already?
For the Shabbat After Pesach: The reason for saying Pirkei Avot between Pesach and [Shavuot] is because every Jew is obligated to purify himself during the days of counting (the Omer), as the Jewish people purified themselves then from the impurity of Egypt. As it is known from the holy Zohar, the seven weeks are like the matter of the seven days of menstrual impurity. And that is why we say Tractate Avot then, so as to see and understand all the good character traits that are mentioned there, and to yearn and desire, "When will I do this, even I?" As well as to repent fully before God, may He be blessed. And that is why there are five chapters, corresponding to the five overall gates of understanding, each of them consisting of ten - these are the fifty gates of understanding, the world of repentance. And these days are called Mi according to the nations of the world; and they also concede that these days are good and fortuitous for healing. And Mi (the numerical count of the letters, mem and yod) is the number fifty (the number of days from Pesach to Shavuot). But what is essential is that these days are good and fortuitous for the healing of the soul. And so may it be His will that God should heal, and we shall be healed, Amen!
For Shavuot: In the holy Zohar, regarding the verse “And the two of them went on” (Ruth 1:19): “The two hehs went.” To understand this, it seems to me as follows: Naomi represents the mystery of the upper holy ה (heh), the world of Binah, the pleasantness (noam) of the Yud — that is, the bond of delight among the supernal holy worlds. For the essential connection among the worlds is through the mystery of the ה. Ruth represents the lower holy ה, the mystery of Malkhut. This is the meaning of the teaching of our Sages: “Why was she called Ruth? Because from her descended David, who saturated the Holy One Blessed Be He with songs and praises.” For the lower ה corresponds to the Divine Name Adonai, whose full spelling numerically equals 671. The expanded letters themselves equal 606, which is the numerical value of Ruth (רות). What remains are the essential letters of the Name Adonai itself, which are in the mystery of David, as is known. Here, however, the expansion stands higher than the root letters of the Name. Thus “from her descended David.” Understand this well. Moab numerically equals 49, corresponding to the forty-nine gates of impurity, Heaven forbid. King David, who emerged from them, slew and purified the holy sparks from among them. This is the meaning of “He measured them with a line” — that he measured them with the line of truth, discerning and understanding within which of them there existed holy sparks requiring purification. He bound together and purified the forty-nine gates. Then “the two of them went” — the two hehs. For through his unification, purification, and rectification of the forty-nine gates, they became united in the mystery of the fiftieth gate from the fifty gates of understanding. Through this there was effected a union of the supernal fifty gates — the upper ה — with the fifty gates of the lower ה. Thus: “the two hehs went.” “Until they arrived at Bethlehem” — for the upper ה is the bond of the hidden, exalted, holy worlds, while the lower ה is the bond and unification of the lower holy worlds. Each one pours forth abundant goodness and blessing: the upper holy ה to the supernal worlds, and the lower ה to the lower worlds. Thus “the two hehs went until they arrived at Bethlehem.” This refers to the “two breads” and to the inwardness of bread, for the letter bet can signify both “two” and “innerness.” Bread (לחם) numerically equals three Divine Names Havayah, the mystery of the upper holy mazal. Twice “bread” equals six Havayah Names — the mystery of the upper and lower mazalot, namely Notzer and Nakeh. This is the mystery of the Two Loaves brought on the festival of Shavuot, and likewise the mystery of the double bread of Shabbat and festivals. The enlightened will understand all this.

“And on the Day of First Fruits…” “You shall perform no laborious work.” At first glance, the phrase “in your weeks” appears to lack any clear explanation, as is evident to any discerning reader. We must also understand: Why is this holy festival called the Day of First Fruits? And why is the offering called “a new offering”? All of this requires explanation.

With awakened understanding, one may explain as follows: Scripture states, “Israel is My firstborn son.” We must understand why the Children of Israel are called bekhor (“firstborn”). One may say: It is written, “Israel is holy to the Lord, the first of His produce.” It is known that Israel arose first in Divine thought before creation, and they are called children of the Omnipresent, as it is written: “You are children to the Lord your God.” Birth cannot occur except through a receiving aspect, a feminine aspect, as it were. Now, the letter א (alef) is the head of all the letters and stands, כביכול, in the role of a father/root. Likewise, the letter י (yud) is the root and father of the tens, and the letter ק (kuf) is the root and father of the hundreds. This is the arrangement: א־י־ק ב־כ־ר ג־ל־ש and so forth. The letters ב־כ־ר (bekhor) are the second letters among the units, tens, and hundreds. They therefore represent the receiving principle, the feminine aspect. From there emerged the root of the souls of Israel, in the mystery of: “Israel is holy to the Lord, the first of His produce.” Therefore, the people of God, children of the Living God, are called bekhor, “the firstborn.

According to this, we may now explain why the firstborn’s right to inheritance depends specifically upon “the first of his strength.” In contrast, the sanctity of the firstborn in all matters depends upon “opening the womb.” Based on what was explained above, this may be understood clearly: With regard to inheritance, a son inherits from the father, as explained earlier in Parashat Bo. However, with regard to holiness, the matter pertains to the first revelation of divinity. This is rooted in the mystery of the Supernal Mother, from whom the source of revelation is opened, through the mystery of the closed mem and the open mem. Therefore, the matter depends upon “opening the womb,” that is, the opening of the closed membrane. The word רחם (“womb”) has the numerical value of Isaac, alluding to the constricted powers of judgment. Understand this well. I once heard from the holy Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev, of blessed and holy memory, Av Beit Din of Berdychiv, that the secret of bringing the first fruits is this: Those fruits that contain the purest and most elevated holy sparks ripen first. Therefore, the Creator, blessed be He, commanded that they be brought first to the Holy Temple. Thus were his holy words. Likewise, the congregation of Israel, called “firstborn” as explained above, is also called “first fruits” because they were chosen first for holiness. Especially on this holy festival. For in the future it is written: “Then I will transform the peoples to a pure language, so that all may call upon the Name of the Lord.” Yet the people of God, children of the Living God, were chosen first on this holy festival through receiving the holy Torah. Therefore, this holy festival is called the Day of First Fruits. This is the meaning of: “And on the Day of First Fruits, when you bring a new offering to the Lord.” This may also be understood through the teaching found in Talmud: A city belonging to the public that became the possession of an individual may not be enclosed entirely within an eruv; a remainder must be left outside so that the laws of the public domain are not forgotten, except for a “new city in Judah” that had fifty dwellings. We must understand why specifically fifty dwellings require no remainder, and why the halakhah rules that such a “new city” itself requires no remainder at all. One may explain: The secret of the eruv is the mystery of unifying and binding together the upper worlds with the lower worlds through the union of the Divine Names Havayah and Adonai, so that external forces may have no hold. Therefore, a public city requires a remainder area, so that the concept of the public domain is not forgotten, as Rashi explains. For the public domain symbolizes a place where the external forces may gain hold, Heaven forbid. The purpose of the eruv is to bind and unify holiness so that the external forces have no hold. Nevertheless, some place outside the eruv must remain available for their grasp; therefore, a remainder is required. However, when there are fifty dwellings, no remainder is needed. For every portion of the Land of Israel hints at the holy land of the desire for life, the mystery of the holy kingship below. Just as in the world of Binah, the upper ה, there are fifty gates through the five final letters מנצפ״ך, each containing ten, thus totaling fifty gates corresponding to this festival of Shavuot and the mystery of the Fiftieth Gate known to those who understand hidden wisdom, so too there are fifty gates within the holy kingship below the lower ה. These must be united and bound together: the fifty above with the fifty below. Through this, the external forces lose all hold upon the holy kingship, Heaven forbid. Instead, “His kingdom rules over all.” This is the secret behind the requirement for a remainder in the eruv, except in the case of the “new city” in Judah that contained fifty dwellings, for there exists a place suitable for the indwelling of the holiness of the supernal Fifty Gates. It is known from the holy books that the festival of Shavuot corresponds to the Fiftieth Gate of Understanding. This is: “when you bring a new offering to the Lord.” Meaning: the drawing near and binding together of the fifty gates of the lower ה, called “new,” for it represents the renewal of the worlds and the revelation of all hidden holy powers, the mystery of the holy kingship. Through its drawing near and unification with the Fifty Gates of the upper ה, the world of Binah, “in your weeks,” meaning: through our counting and sanctifying ourselves during the days of the Omer. We count forty-nine days and seven weeks, corresponding to the river from which emerge seven Sabbaths. By unifying, binding, and purifying the forty-nine gates, we naturally arrive at the Fiftieth Gate. This is the meaning of: “in your weeks” through the seven weeks. For the Holy One, blessed be He, cherishes the seventh: the seventh day holy Shabbat, the seventh year the Sabbatical year, and likewise the seventh of the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy: “Truth.” For the seal of the Holy One Blessed Be He is Truth. “A holy convocation shall there be for you.” Then you will come to the level and attribute of: “Israel is holy to the Lord, the first of His produce,” which corresponds to hidden holy wisdom. And when you attain this level: “You shall perform no laborious work.” Then you will no longer need to seek spiritual techniques and contrivances in serving God. Rather, without any labor at all, your worship will become whole and pure. May it be His will. Amen. And the enlightened will understand all this.
